_doc: NONASK-1103 I-A6 D4 (owner R-049/R-050): seed/fallback for the shared per-source permission record read by vera/source_permissions.py. Three gates (read, use_for_answer, ingest), each with a dev-trace reason code and a plain public phrase. Public phrases never carry a host or URL. Unknown = allowed for read and use_for_answer; ingest needs an explicit storage licence AND registry ingest_verdict not forbid.
_deny_note: deny_hosts is the owner deny-list: ACTIVE, empty by default, owner-editable. An entry is a host (exact host or any subdomain). A listed host is never fetched and never used.
_kill_switch_note: No switch lives here. The web-read kill switch is inline.web_read_enabled (ships true); this file only defines permissions. Emptying deny_hosts and loosening registry verdicts are the owner's levers.

read.read_robots_disallow: not read: the site does not permit automated access
read.read_registry_forbid: not read: the site does not permit automated access
read.read_deny_list: not read: the site does not permit automated access
read.read_login_paywall: not read: the page requires a login or payment
read.read_no_crawl: not read: the site does not permit automated access
read.read_arxiv_portal: not read: arXiv is used only to find original sources

use_for_answer.use_tdm_reserved: not used: the source does not permit reuse
use_for_answer.use_nd_licence: not used: the source does not permit reuse
use_for_answer.use_no_ai_signal: not used: the source does not permit reuse
use_for_answer.use_registry_forbid: not used: the source does not permit reuse

ingest.ingest_no_storage_licence: not stored: the licence does not allow storage
ingest.ingest_registry_forbid: not stored: the source does not permit storage
ingest.ingest_not_readable: not stored: the page was not read
ingest.ingest_not_usable: not stored: the source does not permit reuse
ingest.ingest_unevaluated: not stored: storage is decided after the page is read
